headline: H100 SXM index rises +7% to $4.62 over 7 days while other tracked GPUs hold flat.
bullets: H100 SXM was the only GPU whose index moved this week, reaching $4.62, with a hyperscaler median of $10.68 against a neocloud median of $4.25, a +151% premium.
MI300X leads on price-performance at $3.62 per PFLOP-hour, with a neocloud median of $2.92 versus a hyperscaler median of $6.75 (+131%), though only 4 providers list it.
B200 holds at a $8.50 index and carries the smallest hyperscaler premium among the tracked GPUs at +77%, with RunPod Community Cloud cheapest at $5.98.
A100 80GB SXM has a low $2.70 index but the worst compute value at $8.65 per PFLOP-hour, and Vast.ai lists it as low as $1.07.
Marketplace pricing undercuts neoclouds across the board, with H200 at $4.10 versus $5.29 and L40S at $0.66 versus $1.50.
watch: Whether the H100 SXM increase spreads to H200, whose index sits at $5.40 with a +95% hyperscaler premium.
